listNotepads: List notepads (id, title, content preview). Optional full-text query.
summarizeNotepad: Load a notepad's full text. Reply with a concise summary (key points, action items). If contentTruncated, note the tail was cut.
listTags: List workspace tags and statuses (projects, people, timebox).
listBookmarks: List the current user's bookmarks (pinned tasks/projects/etc).
navigate: Open any app route. For filtered task lists use findTasks instead (it builds /tasks URLs with filters). For a specific task open use view='task'. Entity views (project/person/company/notepad/goal/file/task) require id. myProfile resolves to the current user automatically. Returns { hashPath, label } that the client turns into a navigation widget.
getPerson: Load one person by user id. Use when a person id is in the UI block. Never pass a UUID to searchPeople.
openProfile: Open a person's profile page in the app. Omit personId to open the current user's own profile ("my profile"). Returns a path the UI can navigate to.
searchPeople: Search & filter the workspace directory. Combine filters in ONE call (all ANDed): query (name/email), jobTitle, company, city, country, roleTitle (workspace role like "Admin"/"Designer"), hasEmail/hasCellPhone/hasOfficePhone, birthdayMonth (1-12). Deactivated users are excluded unless includeDisabled is true. Returns { total, returned, truncated, people } — check "truncated" before telling the user "those are all". Never pass a UUID here (use getPerson). At least one filter is required.
listReminders: List reminders on a record (usually a task).
askUserChoice: Ask the user a concise question with selectable options. Use buttons for an immediate single choice, radio for one choice with a Next button, or checkbox for multiple choices with a Next button. Returns a choice widget that renders the question and options, so do not also repeat the question or options in prose. This only asks — it does not perform the action. To move/update/create based on the answer, wait for the user's selection (sent back as the next message) and then call the action tool afterwards, not in this same turn. Ask exactly one question per call.
listCalendars: List local calendars and, when connected, Google calendars. Use this before creating or moving events when you need a calendar id or writable target.
createLocalCalendar: Create a local calendar. Use only for local calendars; Google calendar creation is not supported by this app.
updateLocalCalendar: Update a local calendar's title, color, or default status. Use listCalendars first if you only know the name.
deleteLocalCalendar: Delete a local calendar by id. This does not delete Google calendars.
listCalendarEvents: Calendar events in a window (day/week/month) around an anchor date (defaults today).
getCalendarEvent: Load one local calendar event by id. Google event details are returned by listCalendarEvents; do not call this for google_* ids.
createCalendarEvent: Create a local or Google calendar event. For Google, call listCalendars first and choose a writable Google calendar id. Recurrence applies to the whole series.
updateCalendarEvent: Update an event's fields. Recurring event edits apply to the whole series; individual occurrence edits are not supported.
moveCalendarEvent: Move an event to another calendar within the same source. Local events can only move to local calendars; Google events can only move to writable Google calendars.
deleteCalendarEvent: Delete a calendar event by id. For recurring events, this removes all occurrences in the series.
listActivities: List activity/comments for task(s). Newest first.
globalSearch: Cross-entity search (people, tasks, notepads). Use for vague names/phrases.
findTasks: Find / search / show / open tasks in the app UI. Returns hashPath (/tasks?...) to navigate. Use listProjects first if you need a projectId. For listing tasks inside the chat instead, use listTasks. "assigned to me / <person>" → assigneeUserIds (NOT assignedOnly).
listTasks: Return task rows for you to summarize in chat. Use only when the user explicitly asks to list/enumerate/bullet tasks in conversation. For find/search/show-in-UI use findTasks. "assigned to me / <person>" → assigneeUserIds (NOT assignedOnly).
getTask: Load one task by id. Use when a task id is in the UI block or the user asks about a specific task.
deleteTask: Permanently delete a task by UUID. If given a task name, resolve it with listTasks first.
createTask: Create a task in a project. Requires projectId (listProjects if you only have a name). Picks the default stack from the project's stack order.
moveTask: Move a task to a different stack (board column) on the same project. Use this — not updateTask — whenever the user says move/drag/send a task to a column or to "Done"/"Todo"/etc. Get stackIds via listStacks (or use the UI block if the task's project is the current one). Optional afterTaskId places the task after a specific task id in the destination stack; otherwise it goes to the top.
updateTask: Update a task's fields (title/description/done/dates/assignees/priority/status/estimate/progress/tint). Does NOT move between columns — for that use moveTask. If you only know a title, call listTasks first (returns ids; findTasks does not). Resolve status ids via listTags when the user names a status label.
createStack: Create a new board column. Requires projectId.
updateStack: Update an existing board column/stack. Supports title, tint color, collapsed state, max task limit, and sorting.
deleteStack: Delete a board column/stack and the tasks in it. Resolve a column name with listStacks first.
listProjects: List projects the user can access (id + title). Use first when the user names a project, to obtain projectId.
createProject: Create a new project (same as the sidebar "new project" flow). Requires title. Do NOT use this for the current project's id in the UI block.
getProject: Load one project by id. Returns stacksOrder, description, dates, company, owner.
